name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_is_admitted_to_al_raghy_intensive_care_unit_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently admitted to Al-raghy intensive care unit.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently admitted to Al-raghy intensive care unit.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not admitted to Al-raghy intensive care unit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently admitted to Al-raghy intensive care unit.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_heart_disease_now@@known
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's diagnosis of heart disease is known (previously established or documented).

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis of heart disease is known.
